campaign: EKF baro vertical-velocity aid: g_mode_degraded_gnss gate validation
evidence_level: L2 (real firmware + 6DOF plant + sensor models, SIL only)
purpose: The ungated aid caused 3-4 m altitude loss in forward-flight 20 s outage + NE wind (4/40 independent seeds). Gate the aid on g_mode_degraded_gnss (GNSS stale, no fresh flow, position hold degraded to altitude hold) and verify hover benefits remain while flow-aided forward flight is untouched.
gating: g_baro_vel_aid_enable && g_mode_degraded_gnss && GNSS outage age >8 s && altitude >1 m

scenarios.hover20: 30 m, 20 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds; aid off/on same binary
scenarios.hover60: 30 m, 60 s outage, 1 m/s2 wind, 6 dirs x 10 seeds; aid off/on same binary
scenarios.ne_fwd: NE 25/50 m legs, flow, 20 s outage 20-40 s, 1 m/s2 wind, seeds 11-30, aid off/on

ne_fwd.note: This build includes the age-only descent macro, so both arms descend/land from 10 m; the landing is the descent macro, not the aid. The aid is inactive because flow is fresh and g_mode_degraded_gnss=0.

ungated_forward_matrix.result: outage no-wind 0/210 both arms; wind NE 2/210 nav in both arms, but aid added 2/210 altitude-loss tails at seed7; independent NE seeds 11-30 aid-on 4/40 vs aid-off 0/40 (final_alt 6.06-6.92 m)

verdict: Gate prevents the aid from affecting flow-aided forward flight (0 attempts, bit-identical), while hover/descent benefits are unchanged. The aid is therefore only a no-flow GNSS-outage / altitude-hold-degraded feature; default off; requires BFS_GNSS_OUTAGE_ALT_HOLD to set the gate.
caveats: The forward gate test uses a build with the age-only descent macro; the 10 m forward case descends by design, so it cannot measure forward-flight touchdown safety. The aid itself is inactive.
No forward-flight benefit is claimed; the ungated forward matrix is the negative/mixed evidence for not enabling it there.
All numbers are scalar-Eigen SIL L2, not real aircraft.
